text:
Everything has been taken from me: love and strength.

My body, hurled into a city I detest,

does not rejoice even in the sun. I feel that my blood

is frozen.


I am mocked by the mood of the Muse

who watches me and says nothing,

resting her head of dark curls,

exhausted, on my breast.


Only Conscience, more terrible each day,

enraged, demands a great tribute.

And to answer, I cover my face with my hands,

because I have exhausted my tears and my excuses.




1916

translation.title: Everything Has Been Taken from Me
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the speaker's stripped condition and the silent, exhausted Muse.
